name: textarea
useFor: Use for notes and questions to the agent: site notes, criteria in words. Put a Label above it. For a box with a caption or actions inside, use Input Group with a textarea.
constraints: A fixed height that scrolls a short note
title: Textarea
description: The field for more than a line: the field's frame and states with 13px Forest text on 18px lines, 8px above and below. It grows with its content from 72px and is not resized by hand.
